title: Ability to center a widget in the available space, not just in the center of the panel
line: A widget between two flexible spacers is now centered in the free space when a wide widget like the Global Menu stops it from reaching the panel's center.
explanation: Each flexible spacer sizes itself so the widgets between spacers end up at the panel's center, giving the edge groups double weight. When one edge group takes more than half the panel (a long global menu), one spacer's size comes out negative, gets clamped to 0, and the layout squeezes the rest, so the middle widget is pushed against the menu instead of sitting in the empty area. Now, when any spacer can't reach its centered size, all flexible spacers share the free space evenly, so the middle widget is centered in the space that is left; when panel centering is possible nothing changes.

commits.message:
applets/panelspacer: fall back to centering in the free space

When widgets on one side took over half the panel, like a long global
menu, the widget between flexible spacers got pushed against them. Now
the spacers share the free space evenly, centering it in what is left.

BUG: 512489

patches.diff:
From 82f22ba15e233236e9cef98898c5abc52ce85ed1 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 21:29:34 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/panelspacer: fall back to centering in the free space

When widgets on one side took over half the panel, like a long global
menu, the widget between flexible spacers got pushed against them. Now
the spacers share the free space evenly, centering it in what is left.

BUG: 512489
---
 applets/panelspacer/main.qml | 14 +++++++++++---
 1 file changed, 11 insertions(+), 3 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/panelspacer/main.qml b/applets/panelspacer/main.qml
index 43f0d2c87a..be2bc0eb7a 100644
--- a/applets/panelspacer/main.qml
+++ b/applets/panelspacer/main.qml
@@ -68,10 +68,18 @@ PlasmoidItem {
                 sizeHints[sizeHints.length - 1] += Math.min(child.Layout.maximumHeight, Math.max(child.Layout.minimumHeight, child.Layout.preferredHeight)) + panelLayout.columnSpacing;
             }
         }
-        sizeHints[0] *= 2; sizeHints[sizeHints.length - 1] *= 2
         let containment = Plasmoid.containmentItem
-        let opt = (root.horizontal ? containment.width : containment.height) / expandingSpacers - sizeHints[thisSpacerIndex] / 2 - sizeHints[thisSpacerIndex + 1] / 2
-        return Math.max(opt, 0)
+        let panelSize = root.horizontal ? containment.width : containment.height
+        let freeSpace = panelSize - sizeHints.reduce((total, size) => total + size, 0)
+        sizeHints[0] *= 2; sizeHints[sizeHints.length - 1] *= 2
+        let centeredSize = index => panelSize / expandingSpacers - sizeHints[index] / 2 - sizeHints[index + 1] / 2
+        // When the widgets can't be centered on the panel, center them in the free space instead
+        for (let i = 0; i < expandingSpacers; ++i) {
+            if (centeredSize(i) < 0) {
+                return Math.max(freeSpace / expandingSpacers, 0)
+            }
+        }
+        return centeredSize(thisSpacerIndex)
     }
 
     Rectangle {
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Top panel: Kickoff, fixed spacer, Global Menu (Konsole), flexible spacer, clock, flexible spacer, Show Desktop. The clock is pushed against the menu (spacers 1 px and 429 px)
Same panel with the fix: the clock sits in the middle of the free space (spacers 201 px and 202 px)
With a short left side the clock is still centered on the panel as before
